'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Marc Nickels DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Marc Nickels]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Player:''' [[Marc Nickels]]

* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]

* '''Username:''' Darkbow
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
